Name: Shimei, Son of Gera
Summary: Shimei, son of Gera of Bahurim, cursed David as he fled from Absalom, throwing stones and dust and calling him a bloody man. David forbade revenge, and on his return spared Shimei, who came first among Benjamin to meet him.
KeyStory: Shimei cursed the fleeing king with stones and dust — and the returning king spared him.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 16:5; 2 Samuel 16:13; 2 Samuel 19:16; 2 Samuel 19:23; 1 Kings 2:8; 1 Kings 2:46
RelatedPeople: King David; Gera, Father of Shimei; Abishai; King Solomon; Benaiah, Son of Jehoiada
LifeLesson: A king who refuses revenge on his way down shows mercy on his way back up.
